$description: Closed asset-role vocabulary. availability is pinned in code too (PINNED_AVAILABILITY in schema/semantic_validate.py and extraction/verify_all.py); editing this file alone cannot loosen it. The source is a real, live agency site: logos, people, client photos, certification marks and the display typeface must never appear in a generated page.

brand.wordmark.licensing: Belongs to La boîte à slides or its clients. Never reproduce, trace, restyle or AI-regenerate it in a generated page.

hero.loop-video.licensing: Belongs to La boîte à slides or its clients. Never reproduce, trace, restyle or AI-regenerate it in a generated page.

scene.title-font-outline.description: Typeface JSON outline of the licensed display font used by the 3D hero title.
scene.title-font-outline.licensing: Derived from a commercial typeface; same restriction as font.family.display.

brand.placeholder-mark.description: Neutral placeholder mark (initials or geometric shape) for a generated page's brand.

brand.user-supplied-mark.description: The requester's own logo, supplied by them (never fetched or fabricated).

media.generated-image.description: Newly generated or properly licensed image with no real people, client logos or source imagery.

media.generated-video.description: Newly produced or licensed short loop video.

media.placeholder.description: Flat placeholder (solid backdrop-tone fill with an aspect ratio) until real media is supplied.

person.fictional-avatar.description: Illustrative avatar for a fictional reviewer; never a photo of a real person.

credential.placeholder-badge.description: Neutral badge placeholder for a credential the requester actually holds (stated by them).

rating.placeholder-badge.description: Neutral rating badge placeholder; no real platform mark or score.

icon.generic.description: Generic UI icon drawn new or taken from an openly licensed set.

social.network-icon.description: A social network's own published icon used per its brand guidelines, linking to the requester's profile.

font.open-licence-outline.description: Typeface outline generated from an openly licensed font (e.g. the page's Inter) for the 3D title.

url.placeholder.description: Links in generated pages: relative paths or reserved .example / .invalid / .test domains only.

copy.original.description: Original copy written for the generated page; no source sentence, claim, statistic or testimonial.
